description: The app's secret login key, for apps that already have their own users ("Tu propio login" in neblla_get_llms({ section: "identidad" })). Their server calls POST https://neblla.com/api/apps/<appId>/auth/token with Authorization: Bearer <key> and { externalId, email?, emailVerified?, name? }, gets a one-use token valid one minute, and the front calls neblla.auth.login({ token }). action "create" makes the key (refused if one exists), "rotate" replaces it (the old one stops working at once), "status" says whether one exists, "revoke" removes it. The key is returned ONLY by create and rotate: tell the developer to put it in their server's environment, never in the app's code. Whoever has it can sign in as any user of this app — treat it like a Stripe key.
name: neblla_auth_secret
